items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: we'd contact or run into these different good teachers... His name was Caruso... He just had a reunion here not long ago and invited us all back

ctx.x: I see. Then the next part of the private instruction you had was in New York, is that right?

While I was in the theaters and things in New York, we'd contact or run into these different good teachers. I would say -- come on and teach me a few things, your secrets and all. There was several of those kind of fellows, and one was a saxophone teacher of all things. He -- but he was very good. He had a terrific ear for getting the tone and the different attack. His name was Caruso. I
can't think of his last name. He just had a reunion here not long ago and invited us all back to -- to his reunion in New York, but I was unable to go because I was in Washington at the time.
